scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Cocos?
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
你獵殺夠50只松鼠了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
嗯，你好像還沒獵殺夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Remember, I need help hunting Cocos so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
記住，我需要你幫忙獵殺松鼠，去殺夠50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
確定要放棄狩獵嗎？
目前的任務進度都會清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
好吧，改變主意了就回來找我。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

[Nutters]
I..I just can't seem to find any.
Pesky Coco's have hidden all the Acorns.
Do you think you could help me?
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
我...我怎麼也找不到。
討厭的松鼠把橡果全藏起來了。
你能幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:

Oh, that's great! I knew I could count on you, just from looking at you!

[納特斯]
哦，太好了！
一看見你，我就知道你靠得住！

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Can you help me find ^00CE0025 Acorns^000000.
I will reward you with much if you can.
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
幫我找來^00CE0025個橡果^000000，好嗎？
找到了我一定重謝。

scripts.text: I have 25 Acorns
scripts.translation: 我有25個橡果

scripts.text: Please come again?
scripts.translation: 你說什麼

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Oh great you found out where they were hiding them.
Gimme Gimme!!!
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
太好了，你找到它們藏橡果的地方了！
快給我，快給我！！！

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Oh that's right, sorry I just love roasting Acorns. Mmm.
Here is what I promised you.
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
啊，對了，抱歉，我實在太喜歡烤橡果了。
嗯...這是答應給你的獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Where are my ^00CE00Acorns^000000?
Hey, I'm not playing, you better not hold out on me.
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
我的^00CE00橡果^000000呢？
喂，我可沒開玩笑，別藏著不給我啊。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
I need ^00CE0025 Acorns^000000.

[Nutters]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Cocos.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[納特斯]
好，那就幫我獵殺些松鼠吧。
你打算殺多少隻？
